newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Limited recovery seen for Philippine bourse.
newsitem.headline: Limited recovery seen for Philippine bourse.

text.p: The Philippine bourse will stage a technical rally next week but its gains are likely to be limited due to uncertainty over the political situation, analysts said.

The stock market lost 5.0 percent, or 157.76 points, week-on-week to close at 2,973.59 due to the realignment of foreign funds and the ousting of Senate president Neptali Gonzales, who was closely allied with the government.
"We expect the market to challenge 3,000 points. It's cheaper than it used to be," said Saturnino Mejia of Guoco Securities.

"Nevertheless, with the political uncertainty and possible delay in the passage of tax reforms, there would be no aggressive positioning from foreign investors," said Joel Mendoza of Urbancorp Securities.
He added that foreign funds will have a neutral weighting on the Philippines. They would watch out for the new Senate president's move on crucial tax reform bills.
But the market is likely to be underpinned by positive corporate earnings which would soon start trickling in, he said.
